# Like Like Drive Inn

> > Authentic Hawaiian drive-in restaurant in Honolulu serving traditional plate lunches, Loco Moco, and local favorites since its founding by Alice Nako.

Like Like Drive Inn is a beloved Hawaiian restaurant offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner with classic island dishes including Spam Musubi, Poke Bowls, and Haupia. Located near Waikiki with convenient trolley access, the restaurant embodies the aloha spirit while serving authentic local cuisine.

## Key Topics

- Hawaiian plate lunch
- Loco Moco
- Spam Musubi
- Poke Bowls
- Haupia
- Alice Nako (founder)
- Drive-in service
- Honolulu dining
- Waikiki Trolley access
- Authentic Hawaiian food
- Aloha spirit
- Royal Kona Coffee
- Local Hawaiian cuisine
